jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of games played by millions?
As a Principal Server Engineer at Snowprint, you are part of a game team, designing, developing and operating the game. You'll combine hands-on development with long-term technical vision. Everything you do impacts the player experience and how we build games.
At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and taking ownership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take responsibility, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.
What you’ll be doing
Together with the team, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction of our backend systems, designing and implementing solutions that support both current game features and future needs. You'll take the lead on complex technical features.
You'll work on both player-facing features and the systems, tooling and infrastructure behind them. This includes evolving our existing architecture, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring our backend solutions remain scalable, maintainable, efficient and secure as our games grow.
You'll also play an important role in the technical development of the team. Working closely with other developers, you'll share knowledge, challenge ideas, provide technical guidance and help establish good practices. You'll collaborate with designers and other disciplines to ensure that technical decisions support both development needs and the player experience.
Is this you?
You're a highly experienced server/backend engineer with a strong background in designing, building, and operating complex backend systems. You're fluent in Kotlin and/or Java.

You have experience shaping backend architecture and making technical decisions that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability.

You're comfortable taking ownership of cloud infrastructure and have hands-on experience operating cloud environments.

You have extensive experience with live services and understand the demands of keeping a game running. You're comfortable troubleshooting production issues, adapting to changing priorities, and finding solutions when things don't go as planned.

You're a strong technical voice who enjoys sharing knowledge, challenging ideas, and helping others grow. You communicate clearly, collaborate well and can explain complex technical decisions to people from different disciplines.

Where you’ll work
Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.
About Snowprint Studios
Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.
At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!

jobs.occupation: AI Lead Engineer | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity    Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI  contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. 
  
 This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
  
 Your journey within the Innovate Program will start as AI Lead Engineer within Business Area Networks. 
  
      What you will do    AI is not a side project in our R&D organization — it is changing how we design, build, verify and release products. We are looking for an AI Lead Engineer who wants to be at the front of that change from day one. Your mission is to investigate and transform how R&D works with the help of cutting-edge AI techniques. Concretely, that means:  
  Map and challenge existing R&D workflows and processes — from requirements and design through implementation, verification and release — and identify where AI creates real leverage. 
 Prototype and pilot solutions using modern AI techniques: large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, code intelligence and automation of engineering toolchains. 
 Turn successful prototypes into adopted ways of working: measure the impact, document it, and drive towards large-scale AI development in the organization. 
 Act as a technical reference point for AI in your organization — sharing what works, being honest about what does not, and raising the AI literacy of the engineers around you. 
 Work across unit and country borders within RAN Services product development, regarding tooling, data and AI competence. 
  
 
 You will bring:
  Technically oriented, with an AI-first mindset: your instinct is to ask what part of this problem AI should solve before doing it by hand.  
 Hands-on with AI/ML in practice — through studies, thesis work, internships or personal projects.  
 You can code (Python or similar) and you are comfortable with modern AI tooling.  
 Curious and structured: You can break a messy, undefined process into something you can measure and improve.  
 You take ownership and follow things through to an outcome, not just to an idea.  
 You communicate clearly and can convince experienced engineers to change how they work.  
 Fluent in English.  
 You have a global attitude and willingness to relocate internationally for one 6-month rotation.  
  
 
 Note on the title: “Lead” here refers to leading the AI agenda and technical direction in your area, not to line management. Formal leadership experience is not required. 
   
 In addition, you have: 
  MSc or PhD (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics or related field.  
 Ability to develop strategies and prioritize activities. 
 Interest in experimentation and innovation with the ability to think creatively and be well adapted to change.  
 Knowledge of wireless communication, radio networks and AI & machine Learning. 
 Experience in software engineering or development with hands-on programming. 
 Solid networking, collaboration and communication skills and proficiency in English.  
  
 
 Pre-offer checks including references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

At Web Manuals, we’re redefining aviation with our state-of-the-art SaaS solutions.
Our mission?
To revolutionize how aviation professionals work while reaching new heights of innovation and service. As a bootstrapped company, we chart our own course, breaking barriers and setting our sights on the stars and beyond. With offices in Malmö (HQ), San Diego, New York, Singapore, Sydney and Barcelona, we are proud to offer an environment where you can soar, both professionally and personally, and explore a world of opportunities within an international team. Now, we are on the hunt for a Quality Coordinator to join our team in Malmö!
Take the leap and join Web Manuals on our journey to revolutionize aviation – apply today!
About the role
As Quality Coordinator at Web Manuals, you will work with our quality management system and help build a growth-enabled business based on continuous improvement. You will also play a leading role in our planned ISO 14001 implementation, helping us extend our management system into environmental management. Beyond quality, you will govern the full lifecycle of our supplier contracts, from evaluations and audits to negotiations and keeping our contract repository up to date. You will be the go-to person in the organization for supplier contract matters.
You will report to our General Counsel and work closely with our Information Security Specialist in the Legal & Compliance Team. Together you will manage audits and compliance reporting, and you will support our ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 audits. You’ll also support our Commercial and Customer Success teams in answering RFP questionnaires where applicable. You will be the main contact for our certification body, customers and suppliers on quality matters, so clear communication and a collaborative approach will be key.
Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Ensuring compliance with ISO 9001.
Leading our planned ISO 14001 implementation, from gap analysis to certification.
Managing the Deviation Report Process, including following up on analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
Planning and conducting internal audits and management reviews, and managing customer and supplier audits.
Driving continuous improvement of our Management System, and publishing revisions of the Management System Manual.
Preparing monthly compliance reports, and contributing to our Annual Compliance Report.
Managing supplier contracts throughout their lifecycle, and keeping our Supplier CLM up to date.
Holding recurring quality meetings and training to build awareness of quality, the environment and supplier governance across the company.

What we’re looking for:
Post-secondary degree within a relevant field.
Previous experience with quality management or a similar role.
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and the principles of management systems.

To thrive in this role, we believe that you have:
A structured, detail-oriented approach, and you’re comfortable maintaining controlled documents.
The ability to engage colleagues across the company in quality and continuous improvement.
Clear and professional communication skills in English, both spoken and written, as English is our corporate language.

Ideally but not required, you also have:
Experience from the SaaS and/or aviation industries.
Experience from auditing or contract management.
Experience from work or studies in an international environment.
A curiosity about environmental management and sustainability.

Other information
Start date: January/February
Location: Malmö
Work extent: Full-time, permanent
As part of our recruitment process, we use the Predictive Index (PI) assessment to ensure a great fit between your skills and our company culture.

Reports to: Primary Principal
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Description/Purpose
A teacher at the Stockholm International School is responsible for the quality education of students in relation to the SIS curricula and programs of study. They work to stimulate and motivate students towards high academic performance and commitment to lifelong learning, as well as to prepare students for continuing education at SIS and other educational institutions.
A teacher at SIS is aware of and understands their importance for the academic development and psycho-social education of students. They support the students in their development as global citizens. They contribute to the school's ongoing development, and thus to the positive reputation of the school.
A teacher always keeps in mind the SIS motto: Valued, Challenged, Balanced, Prepared.
Duties/Responsibilities: 
To provide an excellent education for Primary students (Grades 1 to 5).
Contributing to the development and implementation of the curriculum.
Communicating regularly with parents. 
Be an active and contributing member of the School’s faculty. 
Participating in the full range of professional activities in the school. 
Actively contributing to the operational needs of the school. 

Preferred qualifications and attributes:
Teaching qualification
Experience as a teacher. 
Excellent communication skills in English, at a native speaker level. 
The ability to establish rapport with adults and students. 
The ability to plan collaboratively and work effectively in a team 
A pleasant and friendly personality. 
The ability to function effectively under pressure. 
The ability to show initiative and work independently.

It would be desirable for the successful applicant to have a working knowledge of an inquiry-based learning program, IB PYP or their equivalent. Experience working with students from diverse cultures and countries would be an advantage. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check, as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation.

Contract:
Parental Leave Replacement
Starting 10th January, 2027
Ending 26th February, 2027
Employment rate: 100%
Salary: 
Based on a salary scale.
Application:
Last day for applications: December 3rd, 2026. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. SIS reserves the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found. Please send a letter of interest, your CV and two references to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Primary Teacher”

Project Manager - Customer Implementations
Ehra Talent Solutions · Kalmar · Consultant assignment, with openness to permanent employment
Do you want to own customer implementations from kickoff to go-live, and be the person who brings customers, consultants and technology partners together? Ehra Talent Solutions is looking for an experienced Project Manager for our Talent business area.
We are primarily looking for an independent consultant for an assignment, but we are also open to permanent employment for the right candidate.
About us
We are a SaaS company dedicated to the employee journey. We provide the tools and knowledge that help our customers attract, hire, and develop their talent. With 60 colleagues across five countries, Sweden, Norway, Latvia, the UK, and the Netherlands, we are united by a single mission: helping our clients create the world’s best workplaces. https://ehratalentsolutions.com/
The role
You will lead implementations of our learning and talent management solutions for mid-sized and large organisations in the Nordic private and public sectors. Projects range from 200 to 1,000 hours, and you will typically run 2–5 in parallel. They include new implementations, migrations from other platforms, and expansions with new modules or business units. Your key objective is transparency and predictability, so that customers get what was agreed, on time and within budget.
You will
Support Sales in presales and scoping by clarifying requirements and estimating hours, resources and timeline, so that what is sold can be delivered
Plan, lead and follow up projects covering workshops, configuration, integrations (HR systems, SSO), data migration, testing, training and go-live
Lead a cross-functional team of solution consultants, integration specialists and partner resources, as well as the customer’s own project team
Manage scope and change requests and keep time reporting and invoicing aligned with the contract
Run steering groups and status reporting, and secure a structured handover to Customer Success
Contribute to developing our delivery methodology

Who you are
Must have
At least three years’ experience leading customer-facing IT or SaaS implementation projects
Experience managing scope, hour-based budgets and change requests with external customers
Fluent Swedish and confident English, written and spoken, as you will work with customers and partners in both languages
A relevant degree or equivalent experience

Strong advantage
Experience from LMS, HR or talent management systems
Understanding of integrations, SSO and data migration
Project management certification such as PRINCE2, PMP, Scrum or SAFe
Experience working with external partners in a distributed organisation

You are structured and calm across several projects at once. You build trust with customers at both operational and management level, and you lead people without formal line authority. You are comfortable saying “no”, or “yes, as a change request”.
What we offer
You will have a central role in a growing Nordic company and a collaborative team with real influence on how we deliver. For employees, we offer benefits including pension, wellness allowance, health insurance, extra days off and development opportunities.
Practical details
Engagement - Consultant assignment or permanent employment
Location - Kalmar or Stockholm
Travel - Occasional customer visits
Start - By agreement
Reports to- Business Area Director
Process - Includes candidate tests and background checks

How to apply
Send your application in Swedish or English. In your application, please tell us:
Whether you prefer a consultant assignment or employment, or are open to both
Your availability and earliest start date

We will carry out selection and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible. If you want more information about the service, you are warmly welcome to contact anders.madsen@ehratalent.com
We look forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Cost Accounting Manager for an international company – south of Malmö
jobs.description:
With more than 30 years of experience in the industry, we are one of the most established recruitment and staffing agencies in southern Sweden. As a trusted specialist, we have extensive knowledge of the regional job market and business community. We combine our experience with a personal and dedicated approach, enabling us to compete successfully with the largest players in the market. We recruit managers and specialists at all levels within Engineering, Logistics, Sales, Finance, and Office Administration. Our operations cover the Skåne region and the Greater Copenhagen area, and our office is centrally located at Gustav Adolfs Torg in Malmö.
 
Cost Accounting Manager for an international company – south of Malmö

Are you a skilled finance executive? Would you like to take on a key role in a small and rapidly expanding manufacturing company? Do you also have an eye for details and do you like the idea of products being manufactured in Sweden and sold worldwide? Then this could be your next opportunity!
Our client is an independent Swedish business unit (turn-over 150 MSEK) operating in an international business structure who develops and manufactures at their Swedish site in the Trelleborg area. The company is currently in an exciting development phase and is now looking for a Finance Manager who can take on responsibility for the finance function in Sweden.
This is a broad and hands-on finance management role: you will run the month-end close and personally prepare project costing, over-time revenue recognition, inventory valuation, reconciliations and the Group reporting package, supervising one Finance Assistant. The role works day-to-day with the MD and Project Managers to keep project costs and margins accurate. You will play a key role in supporting the business with financial insight, investment analysis, and decision-making support that drives performance and long-term development.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Own the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close
Deliver reliable financial reports and monitor results over time
Lead the budget and forecast work and analyse the company’s finances
Plan liquidity and optimise working capital
Oversee accounting for projects, stock and production costs
Produce analyses, investment proposals and data that support management decisions
Make sure the company follows accounting rules, tax law and internal control requirements
Improve and build out finance processes, procedures and systems

Your Profile:
You have a relevant degree in e.g. business administration, finance, or accounting and several years of experience in the field. You have strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken. Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (preferably Microsoft Dynamics BC) is essential.
You have a good understanding of US GAAP and Swedish statutory requirements. Experience from manufacturing or project-based industry is an advantage, as well as experience in a multinational group environment with cross-border reporting responsibilities. Experience in a leadership role is a plus.
As a person, you are a self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet demanding deadlines. You thrive in a dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with practical implementation. You have a high level of integrity and are a good communicator with excellent leadership skills.
 
About the Position:
This is a permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based south of Malmö.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application in English as soon as possible via the application link. For more information about the role, please contact Karin Dahlin, Standby Workteam, +46 733 76 39 88.

We look forward to your application!

Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM) is an IB Continuum School located in central Malmö. We offer the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 360 students representing a wide range of nationalities and cultures. We are proud to be part of a global network of IB World Schools.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation with a long tradition of academic excellence, we are committed to providing a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students are encouraged to become knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As a PHE Teacher in our MYP, you will plan, teach and assess students in Physical and Health Education and contribute actively to their academic, social and personal development.
You will work closely with colleagues within the relevant subject teams and across the school to provide engaging, inclusive and high-quality learning experiences for our students.
Key responsibilities include:

Planning and delivering engaging MYP lessons in PHE

Assessing and supporting students' learning and development

Creating a safe, inclusive and motivating learning environment

Adapting teaching to meet the different needs and abilities of students

Collaborating closely with colleagues and contributing to subject and school development

Building positive and professional relationships with students, colleagues and families

Contributing actively to the wider school community

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a qualified and committed teacher who is passionate about teaching and student development.
You are:

A qualified teacher, preferably with teaching qualifications in PHE

Passionate about creating engaging and meaningful learning experiences

Skilled at building positive relationships with students

Collaborative and comfortable working as part of an international team

Committed to inclusive education and meeting the needs of different learners

Organised, flexible and able to take responsibility for planning, teaching and assessment

Committed to continuous professional growth

Previous experience of teaching within the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly the MYP, is an advantage.
Since English is the working language of the school, you must be able to communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.
Why Join BISM?
At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community where people genuinely care about students, colleagues and learning.
We offer:

An international and multicultural working environment

Opportunities for professional development and growth

Dedicated and supportive colleagues

The opportunity to work within an IB learning environment

The chance to make a positive impact on students' learning and development

Employment Information
Position: PHE Teacher, MYP Employment type: Fixed-term parental leave cover Working hours: Full-time (100%) Start date: January 2027 Duration: One year

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

Studie- och yrkesvägledare 50%

Välkommen till vår skola! Internationella Engelska Skolan i Upplands Väsby öppnade dörrarna för våra elever år 2020. Vi är en F-9 skola med ca 600 elever samt ca 65 anställda.  Vi söker nu en utvecklingsinriktad studie- och yrkesvägledare som vill bidra till att våra elevers drömmar och hopp om framtiden blir verklighet. 

Ditt uppdrag som studie- och yrkesvägledare, är att i samarbete med elevhälsoteamet och övrig skolpersonal arbeta hälsofrämjande, förebyggande och åtgärdande med det pedagogiska uppdraget i fokus för att alla elever ska ges förutsättningar att nå utbildningens mål i en miljö som främjar elevernas välmående och lärande. Studie- och yrkesvägledaren har ett särskilt ansvar för att vidga elevernas perspektiv i syfte att eleverna ska kunna fatta väl underbyggda studie- och yrkesval. 

Arbetet innebär bland annat att delta aktivt i elevhälsoteamet och i det kollegiala lärandet. Du håller motiverande och vägledande individuella elevsamtal liksom vägledning i klass eller grupp. Det ingår också att ge information till vårdnadshavare i enskilda samtal eller på föräldramöten. Uppdraget omfattar årskurserna F-9 där arbetet med att leda, systematisera och följa upp prao i årskurs 8 samt gymnasieval i årskurs 9, periodvis är i fokus.

Du omvärldsbevakar och har ett stort intresse i att hålla dig uppdaterad om olika studievägar, utbildningar och rådande läge på arbetsmarknaden. Du är systematisk och utvärderar kontinuerligt kvaliteten i den vägledning som eleverna erbjuds och är väl förtrogen med skolsystemet. Du initierar och samverkar med samverkanspartners inom exempelvis näringslivet.

Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som studie- och yrkesvägledare inom grundskola. Du har examen för studie- och yrkesvägledare eller en pågående utbildning. 

Som person är du tydlig, trygg och pedagogisk. Du skapar förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du har förmågan att planera och organisera ditt arbete på ett strukturerat och effektfullt sätt. Du sätter självständigt och i samarbete med andra upp mål, organiserar resurser, följer upp och avslutar aktiviteter. 

Du formulerar dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska samt har hög digital kompetens. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i denna rekrytering då det är viktigt för oss att du passar in i vårt team. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. 

Start: Från den 1 december eller enligt överenskommelse. Du kommer att ha en relativt stor möjlighet att påverka ditt veckoschema tillsammans med oss för att eventuellt matcha ett annat uppdrag. 

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av annonsplatser.

Övrigt

Om tjänsten

Internationella Engelska Skolan Värmdö öppnade 2021 och har sedan dess byggt upp en stark skolkultur med tydliga rutiner, höga förväntningar och goda relationer mellan elever och personal. På IES Värmdö arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en trygg, lugn och positiv lärmiljö där elever ges bästa möjliga förutsättningar att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt.

Skolan har idag cirka 610 elever i årskurs F–9 och omkring 65 medarbetare. Vi söker nu en engagerad och trygg elevassistent till lågstadiet som vill vara med och stötta en elev i skoldagen och bidra till en stabil och inkluderande lärmiljö.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som elevassistent arbetar du nära en elev under skoldagen och hjälper till att skapa förutsättningar för eleven att lyckas både socialt och kunskapsmässigt. Du stöttar eleven under lektioner, övergångar, raster och andra delar av skoldagen, och vid behov även under fritidsverksamheten.

Du blir en viktig vuxen i elevens vardag och samarbetar nära med lärare, fritidspersonal, elevhälsa och vårdnadshavare. Rollen kräver tålamod, flexibilitet och ett lugnt och tydligt bemötande. Du behöver kunna anpassa ditt stöd utifrån elevens behov samtidigt som du bidrar till struktur, trygghet och positiva relationer.

På IES Värmdö arbetar vi med gemensamma rutiner och ett nära samarbete mellan olika personalgrupper. Vi söker därför dig som tycker om att arbeta i team och som delar vår övertygelse om att tydlighet, relationer och höga förväntningar hjälper elever att lyckas.

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning på 100 %.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar
- Har erfarenhet av eller intresse för att arbeta med elever med NPF eller andra behov av stöd
- Är lugn, ansvarstagande och lösningsfokuserad
- Har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med elever
- Är flexibel och kan anpassa ditt stöd utifrån situation och behov
- Tycker om att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika yrkesgrupper
- Har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

- Erfarenhet av arbete i skola eller fritidshem
- Utbildning eller kurser inom exempelvis NPF, pedagogik, konflikthantering eller bemötande
- Erfarenhet av lågaffektivt bemötande eller arbete med extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd

Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är trygg, lyhörd och har ett genuint engagemang för att stötta barn i deras utveckling. Du är en stabil vuxen som kan skapa förtroende och bidra till ett lugnt och positivt klimat omkring eleven.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men vi söker någon som är villig att lära sig, samarbeta och vara en aktiv del av skolans arbete kring elevens utveckling och välmående.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

ECAD Tool Owner / EPLAN Specialist for a Global Engineering Environment in Linköping
Description
We are looking for a consultant to take overall responsibility for EPLAN within an international, technology-focused organisation. The assignment combines an understanding of electrical design with application management, user support and the development of working practices. You do not need to know every aspect from day one, but you should understand EPLAN and be able to drive initiatives in collaboration with users, IT and other technical teams.
About the assignment
As ECAD Tool Owner, you will have global responsibility for managing and further developing the EPLAN environment. The role combines technical and coordination responsibilities: gathering business requirements, leading discussions with key users and ensuring that tools, guidelines and integrations evolve in a structured way.
A key part of the assignment is the integration between EPLAN and Teamcenter via XPLM. You will take the lead on project activities related to this integration, including planning user testing and introducing the solution to different user groups. An electrical designer already provides backup support for administration and ongoing project activities, creating a solid foundation for handover and collaboration.
Your responsibilities will include:
Acting as the global administrator and Tool Owner for EPLAN.
Leading and developing the organisation’s key user community.
Gathering requirements, improvement suggestions and user feedback.
Planning and implementing EPLAN updates.
Creating and maintaining guidelines and shared working practices.
Managing licences and related application management activities.
Taking responsibility for the EPLAN infrastructure in collaboration with IT.
Supporting key users and helping resolve issues efficiently.
Taking ownership of the XPLM interface between EPLAN and Teamcenter.
Leading projects related to the further development and rollout of the integration.
Planning user testing and introducing new solutions to the relevant users.

Your profile
You have worked in electrical design and have practical experience with EPLAN. Your background may include roles such as electrical designer, EPLAN administrator, application specialist, CAD/ECAD coordinator or application manager. What matters most is that you understand users’ day-to-day work and can take clear ownership of tool-related matters.
You should be comfortable gathering requirements, coordinating activities and driving initiatives forward with multiple stakeholders. The role suits someone who is structured, communicative and solution-oriented, with the ability to move between technical details and a broader application management perspective.
Mandatory requirements
Experience in electrical design.
Practical experience with EPLAN.
Ability to gather requirements and plan and drive activities.
Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

Desirable qualifications
Experience in EPLAN administration or application management.
Experience with Teamcenter.
Experience with XPLM or similar integrations between ECAD and PLM systems.
Experience with system upgrades, user testing or rollouts to multiple user groups.
Experience leading key user networks or working in an international organisation.

Assignment details
Assignment type: Consultancy assignment
Workload: Full-time, 100%
Location: Linköping, on-site
Start date: As soon as possible
Assignment duration: Six-month periods
Extension: Good prospects for extension
Language: Spoken and written English required
Why this assignment is interesting
This role offers significant practical influence over a core engineering design tool within a global technology organisation. You will work closely with electrical design teams, users and IT while driving an important integration between ECAD and PLM. The combination of technical depth, international collaboration and clear ownership makes this assignment particularly relevant for a consultant looking to move from a dedicated design role into tool ownership and technical application management.
